claims.statement: The AZIZ-selected model is the model consumed by 2D, 3D wall geometry and BOQ in the tested integration candidate.
The integrated Claude -> Gemini -> AZIZ path returns three validated RECT/L/U models and a SELECTED_PRELIMINARY decision for south, north, east and west entry tests.
limitations: This is test-path evidence, not production-runtime evidence.

claims.statement: Integrated project save/restore preserves the selected model and RECT/L/U alternatives exactly in the tested round-trip.
limitations: Historical and production persistence paths are not fully covered by this claim.

claims.statement: The tested dist/claude source files match vendor/claude-planner/src/ byte for byte.
limitations: Explicit per-file SHA values are not yet recorded in the registry.

claims.statement: A runtime Mizan Score implementation exists at dist/mizan-score.mjs and is invoked from dist/app.mjs.
limitations: No runtime trace has yet proven execution in a browser session.
Current implementation is a heuristic and does not yet satisfy the planned V1 specification.
